bullets.text: land runs out at cape ashizuri. south of here is just water and a long argument with the wind.
duck reached kongofuku-ji where the road gives out. a lighthouse turns for ships that never ask. 🕯️
chasing a bug for an hour. it was a comma. it is always a comma.
steady, the way you get steady when the road ends and that turns out to be fine.
to play in the play. the lighthouse does it nightly, no audience, no notes.
